title: LinguoMT-Adapt: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for African Speech Translation

model.description: Base model + adaptation method, e.g. 'Whisper-large-v3 + LoRA'

language.description: Display language name matching our system output

metric.description: One of: BLEU, spBLEU, ChrF, WER, CER

score.description: Score AFTER adaptation — must be a number

citation_key.description: Citation key matching an entry in references.yaml

pretrained_score.description: Score BEFORE adaptation (same model, same eval) — enables before/after comparison

num_ft_samples.description: Number of training samples used for adaptation

trainable_params_pct.description: Percentage of total parameters that were trained (e.g. 0.5 for 0.5%)

reference_fields._comment: Schema for entries in references.yaml. The framework validates each entry and warns on violations — never blocks model training.

author.description: Full author list as a single string

datasets.description: List of dataset names the paper evaluates on, e.g. [FLEURS, AfriSpeech-200]

language.description: Target language. One entry per language.

directions.description: List of task directions reported, e.g. [ASR] or ['Source → English']

metrics.description: List of reported metrics, e.g. [WER] or [BLEU]. 'score' corresponds to metrics[0].

score.description: Numeric score for metrics[0]. null = not yet filled; excluded from comparison tables.

summary.description: 2–5 sentences: what the paper does, what it evaluates, why it is relevant as an adaptation comparator.

notes.description: Where to find the score, caveats, or dataset differences.

num_ft_samples.description: Number of training samples used for adaptation
